description: trust through the CLI: a project-only git source awaiting trust (status's trust line) is trusted for the backend it would use – `trusted source team (git <url>)` – after which status asks for nothing and the sync fetches and installs its skill; a project source whose local directory exists beside its git is trusted as that local path, a user source as its own; an unknown name, a project source with --project-dir the home (no project scope) and a name only Object.prototype knows exit 1 with `unknown source`, nothing written.
